relationships.subject: Mfn2
relationships.evidence_quote: Our study demonstrated that downregulation of Mfn2 leads to mitochondrial dysfunction and ROS accumulation, which promotes the pyroptosis of spinal GABAergic neurons and the development of chronic pain.

relationships.subject: reactive oxygen species
relationships.evidence_quote: The elevated ROS levels, in turn, have been shown to influence pyroptosis at multiple stages, including the priming and activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome and promoting the cleavage of GSDMD [44, 45].

relationships.subject: GSDMD
relationships.evidence_quote: Gasdermin D (GSDMD) is a key executioner of the classical pyroptosis pathway

relationships.subject: pyroptosis
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings indicated that the spinal GABAergic neurons pyroptosis was involved in the SMIR-induced CPSP.

relationships.subject: disulfiram
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicated that repeated DSF administration effectively inhibited the NLRP3–Caspase1–GSDMD pathway and reversed SMIR‐induced mechanical allodynia.

relationships.subject: MASM7
relationships.evidence_quote: Those findings indicated that the Mfn2 activator MASM7 inhibited the GSDMD‐mediated pyroptosis in SMIR rats.

relationships.subject: disulfiram
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blot analysis revealed that, along with the downregulation of the NLRP3‐Caspase‐1‐GSDMD pathway following DSF treatment, the expression of GAD1 was significantly increased compared with the SMIR + Vehicle group (Figure 4K,L).

key_findings: SMIR-induced CPSP involves activation of NLRP3-Caspase-1-GSDMD pyroptosis in spinal GABAergic neurons with GAD1 loss.
Mfn2 downregulation causes mitochondrial dysfunction and ROS; Mfn2 activator MASM7 and GSDMD inhibitor disulfiram reverse allodynia.
